Market today: The mood is cautious, driven by rising interest rates and hawkish Fed expectations. This is a direct headwind for your tech and chip-heavy portfolio, as higher rates make future growth less valuable and increase borrowing costs.

Your holdings: SOXL (-60.26%) and SPAL (-33.64%) are in dire straits, both leveraged ETFs with significant drawdowns and "SELL" statuses. Margin amplifies these drops, making them critical concerns. QQQ (-0.77%) and SMH (-14.91%) are also flagged for "TRIM."

Watch: Keep an eye on the 10-year Treasury yield for further increases and any follow-up S&P 500 target cuts from other banks.

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management on your leveraged and underperforming tech/chip positions given the macro headwinds.
plays: Trim SOXL and SPAL: These leveraged ETFs are deep in the red and flagged "SELL." Cut losses to protect capital and reduce margin exposure.
Trim QQQ and SMH: Reduce exposure to general tech and semiconductors, which are vulnerable to rising rates.
Consider SOXS long: With a bearish outlook on semiconductors, the scanner's SOXS long setup (entry 50.55-50.5, stop 50.07) offers a potential hedge or profit opportunity.
